Please reply with:
1) **Your email** (or, if you prefer, your **first name + last name + zip code**)

Also, quick clarification so I set this up correctly:
- For the **luggage set**: do you want an **exchange** to the red version (same set, different color)?
- For the **skateboard**: do you want an **exchange** to the 34-inch length with the custom design?
- For the **hiking boots**: is it a **return for a refund** (not an exchange)?

Once I have your email + order ID, I’ll pull up the order and confirm the exact items/options available and the correct payment method flow (you mentioned using a **credit card** for the pending modification—I'll verify once I see the order).

I actually don’t remember my email address, sorry. But my name is Liam Thomas and my zip code is 85049. I’m not sure about the order ID either, I just know it was my most recent order.

And yes, for the luggage set, I want to exchange it for the same one but in red. For the skateboard, I want to exchange it for one that’s 34 inches and has a custom design. For the hiking boots, I just want to return them for a refund.

I hope that’s enough info. I’m worried this might be complicated since I don’t have all the details.
